# sonarqube_github_binding (Resource)

Binds a project to a GitHub repository. Requires Developer edition or above. Changes apply in place. Import ID: the project key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pull request decoration requires the Developer edition or higher.
resource "sonarqube_project" "api" {
  name    = "API"
  project = "example-api"
}

resource "sonarqube_github_binding" "api" {
  project     = sonarqube_project.api.project
  alm_setting = "github" # key of a sonarqube_alm_github
  repository  = "example-org/example-api"
  monorepo    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alm_setting` (String) Key of the GitHub setting.
- `project` (String) Project key.
- `repository` (String) Repository, as `owner/name`.

### Optional

- `monorepo` (String) `true` if the repository holds several SonarQube projects.
- `summary_comment_enabled` (String) Post a summary comment on pull requests.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_github_binding.example 'example-api'
```
